mentions.name: Throbol
mentions.description: A programming language and accompanying tools that make it easy to solve hard nonlinear control problems such as robot walking. The project provides videos and source code for 2-legged walking robots running in simulation and 4-legged walking robots running on real hardware.
mentions.problem: Hard nonlinear control problems like robot walking are difficult to solve; the language and tools aim to make them easy.
mentions.source_excerpt: But really, a programming language and tools to make it easy to solve hard nonlinear control problems like walking. There are videos & source code for 2-legged walking robots (in simulation) at https://throbol.com/post/how-to-walk, and videos & source code for 4-legged walking robots (on real hardware) at https://throbol.com/
